package.name: cognitive3d_ros_nav2
package.description: Nav2 behaviour-tree events for cognitive3d_ros. Translates the Nav2 behaviour-tree log into recovery and node-failure events and a tree-activity rate. It ships the node's entry point and its component, cognitive3d_ros_nav2::Cognitive3DNode, with the translators composed in, and cognitive3d_ros's launch file runs that entry point whenever this package is present. Kept separate so that a robot not running Nav2 does not install nav2_msgs.
